title: Hex colors
hints: strings.CutPrefix(s, "#") strips the hash and tells you whether it was there. Expand the short form by doubling each digit: "f80" becomes "ff8800".
strconv.ParseUint(part, 16, 8) parses two hex digits in base 16 and fails if the value doesn't fit in 8 bits. It also rejects signs.
Check that you have exactly 6 digits after expanding, then parse s[0:2], s[2:4] and s[4:6].
